imap_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the IMAP service.

imaps_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the IMAPS (IMAP over SSL) service.

pop3_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the POP3 service.

pop3s_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the POP3S (POP3 over SSL) service.

sieve_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the Sieve (mail filtering) service.

nntp_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the NNTP service (commented out by default).

nntps_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the NNTPS service (commented out by default).

http_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the HTTP service (CalDAV/CardDAV/RSS).

https_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the HTTPS service (CalDAV/CardDAV/RSS).

lmtp_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the LMTP service over TCP (commented out by default).

lmtpunix_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the LMTP service over Unix socket.

smmap_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the Socketmap service (commented out by default).

notify_prefork.description: Number of preforked processes for the notification service (commented out by default).

checkpoint_period.description: Checkpoint period in seconds for the ctl_cyrusdb command.

delprune_at.description: Time of day to run duplicate delivery suppression/Sieve/NNTP pruning in HHMM format.

deleteprune_at.description: Time of day to run message deletion pruning in HHMM format.

expungeprune_at.description: Time of day to run expunge pruning in HHMM format.

tlsprune_at.description: Time of day to run TLS session pruning in HHMM format.
